M8SkillLoader.description: Loads a skill file (prompt text) and outputs it as a knowledge pack for M8 · LLM Inference.

skill.name: skill
skill.tooltip: Pick an uploaded skill file. Use the Upload button on the node to add one.

enabled.name: enabled
enabled.tooltip: Turn off to output an empty skill, as if unplugging the wire without editing the workflow.

extra_text.name: extra_text
extra_text.tooltip: Extra text appended after this skill. Handy for one-off tweaks you do not want to write into the file.

skill.name: skill
skill.tooltip: The loaded skill, feed it into the skill input of M8 · LLM Inference.

M8LLMInference.description: Calls an external LLM over an OpenAI-compatible API: two prompt boxes, model dropdown, thinking effort. Accepts a skill, images and audio; outputs text.

provider.name: provider
provider.tooltip: Pick a provider. Changing it fills in that provider's default base_url and thinking options. For anything else choose Custom and enter the address yourself.

base_url.name: base_url
base_url.tooltip: API address. Defaults to https://api.deepseek.com/v1; point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

api_key.name: api_key
api_key.tooltip: Leave empty to use the key stored on the server (recommended: Save key keeps it out of the workflow file). Anything typed here applies to this node only and is written into the workflow.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: Fill in the address and key, then click Refresh models. You can also type a model name directly.

system_prompt.name: system_prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: System prompt: persona, tone, output format. Leave empty to send only the user prompt.

user_prompt.name: user_prompt
user_prompt.tooltip: What you want to ask. Can be wired from another node's text output.

thinking.name: thinking
thinking.tooltip: Thinking effort. Off sends no extra request; higher asks the model to think more. If the provider rejects the parameter it is dropped and the request retried.

show_thinking.name: show_thinking
show_thinking.tooltip: Show the model's thinking on the node panel (default off: it is usually long). Display only, the text output is unaffected.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Randomness. Lower for steady work like prompt writing, higher for creative ones.

max_tokens.name: max_tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Upper bound on the reply length. It is a cap, not a target.

timeout.name: timeout
timeout.tooltip: Request timeout in seconds. For slow thinking models give it 300 or more.

skill.name: skill
skill.tooltip: Wire this from M8 · Skill Loader. Its content is appended after the system prompt as reference material.

skill_auto.name: skill_auto
skill_auto.tooltip: Inject every uploaded skill and let the model decide which applies. Off by default: once the library grows, each turn carries a few irrelevant ones and burns tokens.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Feed images to a vision model. Multiple images are sent together.

audio.name: audio
audio.tooltip: Feed audio to a model that accepts it (converted to WAV).

extra_params.name: extra_params
extra_params.tooltip: Extra request parameters as a JSON object, merged into the request body.

M8LLMLocal.description: Runs inference on a local GGUF model: no network, no API key. Models live in ComfyUI's models/LLM folder. Pair it with an mmproj file in the same folder to enable vision; a skill node can supply a knowledge pack.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The main .gguf in models/LLM. If the list is empty, check that folder.

system_prompt.name: system_prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: System prompt. Combined with any skill into the system block, skill first.

user_prompt.name: user_prompt
user_prompt.tooltip: What you want to ask this round.

extra_text.name: extra_text
extra_text.tooltip: Extra text appended after the prompt. Good for additional requirements, style constraints, fields to reference.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Images for the model to look at. Without it the run is text only. Needs an mmproj file next to the model.

skill.name: skill
skill.tooltip: Wire the output of a skill loader node here to use it as a knowledge pack.

mmproj.name: mmproj
mmproj.tooltip: Multimodal projection file. Auto-paired by name; pick one manually if that guessed wrong.

ctx.name: ctx
ctx.tooltip: Context length. Larger uses more memory; only needed for long conversations or many images.

gpu_layers.name: gpu_layers
gpu_layers.tooltip: -1 = offload as many layers as the GPU allows. 0 = CPU only.

thinking.name: thinking
thinking.tooltip: Whether the model should show its thinking. Off gives cleaner output.

status.name: status
status.tooltip: How this run went: token count, vision or text, cache hit or fresh load.

M8CameraControl.description: Visual camera positioning: outputs the matching camera prompt (direction split by ratio + height / distance / tilt + lens / depth / motion / composition / style).

pos_x.name: pos_x
pos_x.tooltip: Left / Right (X): -1 is fully left, +1 fully right.

pos_y.name: pos_y
pos_y.tooltip: Up / Down (Y): -1 is looking up from below, +1 from above.

pos_z.name: pos_z
pos_z.tooltip: Near / Far (Z): -1 is close, +1 is distant.

roll.name: roll
roll.tooltip: Roll: tilts the horizon (dutch angle) once past the dead zone.

config.name: config
config.tooltip: Advanced JSON: weight budgets, per-step output, lens / depth / motion / composition / style switches.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.tooltip: The camera prompt, ready to go into a positive prompt.

M8MultiCharacter.description: Edit several characters' prompts and on-canvas regions, assembled into one ready-to-use prompt.

format.name: format
format.tooltip: attn = Attention Couple, regional = Regional Prompts, plain = comma-separated text with no region syntax.

use_fill.name: use_fill
use_fill.tooltip: Fill the areas no character covers with the base prompt.

config.name: config
config.tooltip: The character list as JSON: name, prompt, region (x/y/w/h), blend weight, feather, enabled.

base_prompt.name: base_prompt
base_prompt.tooltip: Base prompt, merged with the global prompt.

width.name: width
width.tooltip: Canvas width the regions are laid out on.

height.name: height
height.tooltip: Canvas height the regions are laid out on.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.tooltip: The assembled prompt, ready for a positive prompt.

M8LLMLocal.noResponse: No response from the backend; is ComfyUI running?
M8LLMLocal.noGpu: This llama-cpp-python has no GPU support, so inference will run on the CPU. Install a CUDA build of the wheel to use the GPU.

M8SkillLoader.textOnly: {name} is a plain text pack with no attachments
M8SkillLoader.uploadSkillTip: Pick a markdown file. It is wrapped into the folder layout automatically (main file named SKILL.md); add resources later any time.
M8SkillLoader.uploadPackTip: Pick a folder and references/ and scripts/ come along. The folder name becomes the skill name; it must contain SKILL.md.
M8SkillLoader.refreshTip: Re-read the list of uploaded skills.
M8SkillLoader.inventoryTip: See which attachments this pack carries and how many get inlined this run (shown in a notification, it does not take up node space).

M8LLMInference.gotModels: Got {n} models, filled into the dropdown
M8LLMInference.keyBoxEmpty: The key box is empty, nothing to save
M8LLMInference.keySavedOnServer: Key saved on the server ({masked}), the box was cleared
M8LLMInference.keySavedHint: Leave this node empty from now on and it uses the server copy; the workflow file never carries the plaintext key
M8LLMInference.refreshModelsTip: Ask the backend for the model list using the current address and key, then fill it into the dropdown below.
M8LLMInference.saveKeyTip: Stores it in m8/data/credentials.json and clears the box, so sharing the workflow does not leak the key.
M8LLMInference.clearKeyTip: Deletes the key stored on the server.
M8LLMInference.thinkingPlaceholder: (the model's thinking shows up here after one run)
M8LLMInference.thinkingTip: Expand or collapse the model's thinking (display only, the text output is unaffected).
M8LLMInference.noThinking: (no thinking this run: the model produced none, or the switch is off)

M8CameraControl.hint.relative: Drag the canvas: grabs the world and rotates it, no jumps
M8CameraControl.hint.absolute: Drag the canvas: the pointer position is the parameter (absolute mapping)
M8CameraControl.nothingToCopy: There is no prompt to copy yet
M8CameraControl.clipboardBlockedHint: Selecting it manually from the preview above works just as well
M8CameraControl.noClipboard: This environment cannot read the clipboard
M8CameraControl.notAConfig: The clipboard does not hold a config object
M8CameraControl.notAConfigHint: It should be JSON in the form { ... }
M8CameraControl.badJsonClipboard: The clipboard does not hold valid JSON
M8CameraControl.topLevelObject: The config must be an object at the top level
M8CameraControl.modeTip: Relative: grabs the world and rotates it without jumps. Absolute: the pointer position is the parameter.
M8CameraControl.hintAbsActive: absolute mapping: the pointer is the camera direction
M8CameraControl.hintRelActive: relative drag: grabs the world and rotates it

M8MultiCharacter.formatHint.attn: Emits COUPLE(x1 x2, y1 y2, weight) syntax for comfyui-prompt-control
M8MultiCharacter.formatHint.regional: Emits prompt MASK(...) joined with AND, for Regional Prompts
M8MultiCharacter.formatHint.plain: Just joins the prompts with commas: no region syntax, no third-party nodes
M8MultiCharacter.noneEnabled: No character is enabled (each one needs a checkmark and a prompt)
M8MultiCharacter.blankInfo: {n} enabled characters have no prompt and will not appear in the output
M8MultiCharacter.fillWarn: There are {n} FILL() blocks; one is usually enough
M8MultiCharacter.fillPlainWarn: Plain text format carries no region syntax, so FILL() will not appear in the output
M8MultiCharacter.overlap: "{a}" and "{b}" overlap by about {p}% of the frame; their tags will interfere with each other
M8MultiCharacter.featherWarn: Feather is large relative to the frame for {names} (over 12% of the short side); edges will smear
M8MultiCharacter.wholeFrame: whole frame: left to right = x, top to bottom = y
M8MultiCharacter.fillLabel: Let the base prompt fill areas no character covers (FILL, attn format only)
M8MultiCharacter.canvasTitle: Drag empty space to create a character; drag a box to move it, drag its bottom-right corner to resize
M8MultiCharacter.syntaxTip: What this character produces in the current format
M8MultiCharacter.noCharacters: No characters yet. Click Add character below to start.
M8MultiCharacter.addCharacterTip: Adds a character (a mask box is created for it automatically)
M8MultiCharacter.confirmReset: Reset the character config back to the built-in two equal regions? Current content will be lost.
M8MultiCharacter.resetTip: Go back to the default two equal regions
M8MultiCharacter.frameTitle: Frame size, decided by the width / height inputs; the canvas is shown at this ratio
M8MultiCharacter.basePlaceholder: Base prompt: the backdrop of the whole frame (forest, indoors, colour tone...)
M8MultiCharacter.presetTip: Load a saved character config preset
M8MultiCharacter.parsePromptInput: Paste a prompt with region syntax (COUPLE / MASK / FEATHER / FILL are supported)
M8MultiCharacter.noRegionSyntax: No recognizable region syntax in that text
M8MultiCharacter.noRegionSyntaxHint: It needs at least COUPLE(...) or MASK(...); plain text has nothing to parse
M8MultiCharacter.parsePromptTip: Turns a region-style prompt you already wrote back into character blocks
M8MultiCharacter.savePresetTip: Store the current character config on the server
M8MultiCharacter.pickPreset: Pick a preset from the dropdown first
M8MultiCharacter.confirmDelete: Delete the preset "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
M8MultiCharacter.deleteTip: Deletes the preset selected in the dropdown
M8MultiCharacter.presetNotObject: That preset does not hold a config object
M8MultiCharacter.presetNotObjectHint: Look at the file under m8/data/prompt-presets/
M8MultiCharacter.globalPlaceholder: Global prompt: appended after the base prompt, applies to every region
M8MultiCharacter.disableTip: Disabled means this character stays out of the output, but its config is kept
M8MultiCharacter.nameTip: Only used to tell them apart on the panel; it never goes into the prompt

M8Core.unreachableHint: Check that ComfyUI is still running, then reload the page
M8Core.notJson: The backend did not return JSON
M8Core.mentionKeys: up/down to choose, Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel
